RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown—there is no defensible 0–100 estimate from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Your longer experience matters, but digital expertise, leadership, strategy and interview performance could legitimately outweigh years served. Neither the appointment nor the delayed response establishes bias.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment and feedback explaining the decision. Frame this around transparency and consistent assessment, not the panel’s sex.

If you uncover sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria or preferential treatment, raise those specifics with your union or an employment adviser. Check local complaint deadlines now; waiting for feedback may not pause them.
